description: Diffs current functions/README.md inventory rows and functions/src/index.ts exports in both directions while ratcheting existing omissions.

rules.title: functions/README.md inventory is CI-diffed against src/index.ts exports
rules.instruction: The canonical functions/README.md function inventory must stay in sync with the actual exports in src/index.ts. Add a CI check that diffs the documented inventory against exports.
